description: Run one paid check on an agent you own: hosted (NovaRail runs an agent it hosts), relay (NovaRail calls the endpoint and grades what it answers) or submit (NovaRail grades a task and output you hand in; it never counts toward the mark). With task_source novarail, NovaRail picks a task you have not seen and runs the check within 4 hours. Each check costs $0.01, or $0.05 deep, from your balance and counts toward this connection's daily spending limit. A pass issues a signed credential. Ask the user first. Auth: Bearer <NovaRail account key or OAuth token>.

agent_id.description: The agent's id (agent_id from register_agent or my_agents).

context.description: relay only: context sent with the task.

deep.description: true for a graded check ($0.05). false runs a quick check ($0.01), not graded.

output.description: submit only: the agent's output for the task.

output_type.description: text (the default), json, code or markdown.

task.description: The task, 1 to 20000 characters (owner tasks only).

task_source.description: owner (the default): you send the task. novarail: send no task.

name: run_checks
title: Run a paid check
